item.title: Re: Can i post without greenlight?
item.content:encoded: Greenlights are required for first time authors to post in the Draft Critique Forum. That being said, there's technically nothing stopping you from posting to the main site without feedback. However, without feedback, you may find that your SCP is quickly downvoted to deletion. I would recommend going through the greenlight process if you want your article to survive on the site.

item.title: Can i post without greenlight?
item.content:encoded: I am a new author and have a completed scp article. is it possible to just post it as i do not want feedback. please reply with an answer.
